jobs.title: Prevention
jobs.description: Jazz | DLP Prevention: Surgical Data Loss Controls Skip to main content Skip to footer Product Detection Investigation Posture Prevention Customers Blog Events Company About DLP Sucks Careers Contact Us Book a Demo Book a Demo Prevention Smart, surgical actions Using deep contextual understanding, Jazz helps you act on risk without disrupting the business by applying the precise, necessary response that each situation calls for. Your browser does not support the video tag. Built for frictionless prevention Make informed, context-driven decisions. Not blunt blocks. Since Jazz understands the data, the user, and the workflow, it can make precise decisions about when and how to intervene – and when not to. Explore Jazz’s adaptive responses Not every situation requires a hard stop. Actually, very few do. Jazz offers a range of proactive responses, depending on the risk: Request a justification If the action is unexpected or potentially risky, Jazz asks the user for a quick explanation before the action moves forward. Guide the user with a prompt When the activity is low-risk but still questionable, Jazz might gently steer the user toward a safer path. Escalate for human review If the action in question is highly sensitive or requires added oversight, Jazz will flag it to a manager or security analyst before allowing it. Apply a targeted block In the rare instance the activity clearly puts sensitive data at risk, Jazz prevents it from happening. Make security secure, not disrupt Sounds obvious, right? See how Jazz helps security teams protect sensitive data while keeping legitimate work moving. Get a Demo Get a Demo Book a Demo Book a Demo © 2026 Jazz Inc.
